title: Admin
subtitle: Internal admin environment of Rewarded. Every lookup and every decision goes into the audit log.

gate.login: Log in with your admin account first.
gate.forbidden: This part is for Rewarded admins only.

mfa.title: Second factor
mfa.intro: Besides the login link, admin access needs a code from your authenticator app.
mfa.already_enrolled: Your second factor is already linked. Enter the code from your app.
mfa.secret_intro: Add this secret to your authenticator app, then enter the code.

form.fill_required: Fill in all required fields first.

overview.title: Overview
overview.coverage_alarm: Coverage alarm: the covered stock value is lower than the value of outstanding points.
overview.principle: Heuristics only flag. A person decides, with a reason code from the fixed list.

flag_code.H2: H2: many accounts on one address

queue.title: Fraud queue
queue.intro: Flagged sessions, reports and reported squad names. Decide within 3 working days; every decision gets a reason code the student sees in plain language.

decision.label: Decision
decision.block_hint: A block only takes effect once a second admin confirms it.
decision.reason_hint: The student sees this reason in plain language.

block.intro: Block proposed by {by}. Only another admin can confirm.
block.done: Block confirmed. The account is blocked.

restore.intro: Restore only with objective evidence: an outage on our side or a buffered log that meets the rules. With hidden that evidence does not exist.
restore.note_hint: For example the outage with its time window or the log that arrived late.

reasons.incomplete_evidence: Too little signal in the session

appeals.title: Appeals
appeals.intro: An admin other than the first decides within 5 working days, with a motivation.
appeals.heading: Appeal against {type} · {user}
appeals.other_reviewer: Whoever worked on the first decision cannot decide here.

four_eyes.title: Four eyes
four_eyes.intro: Decisions a second admin has to confirm.
four_eyes.other: Stopping arm B, switching on the rest arm and deleting an account also need a second admin; they are under Experiments and Users.

sample.title: Sample
sample.intro: Light check per account: anchor, line type, session pattern (including H12) and contact. The judgement follows the criteria fixed in advance and books nothing by itself.
sample.empty: There is no sample right now.
sample.interest_missing: "I have an interest" is still missing: the route is not in contracts v1. Until then, report an interest to the second reviewer.
sample.check_contact: Contact made (institution address with HMAC comparison)
sample.criteria_none: No indication: anchor or contact confirmed.
sample.criteria_suspect: Suspect: for example no anchor and no contact, or an open flag in the week.
sample.criteria_fraud: Fraudulent: two or more criteria from the pre-registration.
sample.flag_opened: A flag was opened in the queue.

first.title: First redemptions
first.intro: Accounts in the 7-day waiting period. Look only; nothing is refused automatically.
first.caption: Accounts in the waiting period
first.empty: No accounts in the waiting period.
first.open_flag_missing: Opening a flag from this list is not possible yet: contracts v1 has no route for it.

outages.title: Outages
outages.intro: Record an outage on our side. Then you see which aborted sessions you can restore.
outages.invalid: Fill in start, end (after the start) and a note.
outages.none_restorable: No sessions in this time window.

clubs.title: Associations
clubs.intro: Member count with an external source, agreement, code with cap, pool, board accounts and help resources.
clubs.caption: Associations
clubs.name: Name
clubs.no_code_reason: No code: record a signed agreement first.
clubs.prize_no_reason: No: without an external member source there is no main prize.
clubs.cap_preview: The code cap will be {cap} (1.1 × member count).
clubs.cap_rule: The code cap is 1.1 × the member count; links above it go to an admin.
clubs.self_warning: Without an external source the association takes part in the ranking, but not for the main prize.
clubs.source_ref: Document reference for the member count
clubs.source_ref_hint: For example the statement for recognition or the faculty's confirmation.
clubs.help_none: None; the general text about the GP and the student counsellor applies.
clubs.board_emails_hint: Separated by commas. They get a board account.
clubs.members_fixed_hint: The member count is fixed and can no longer change.
clubs.fix: Fix the member count before the warm-up ranking
clubs.pending_intro: These members linked after the cap was reached. Approve them only if they are members.
clubs.april_missing: The task "request the external member count for April" and exam calendars per association have no route in contracts v1 yet.

challenges.title: Challenges
challenges.intro: Warm-up ranking, prize period with main and threshold prize and performance challenges with fixed places. Cannot be published without coverage or above the euro caps; the result is final only after the sample and with four eyes.
challenges.list_note: Contracts v1 has no list of challenges for admins. You see the challenges you created or changed in this session, plus the published ones.
challenges.four_eyes_hint: Only an admin other than the one who proposed the result can make it final, and only after the mandatory sample.
challenges.seats_hint: As many places as funded prizes.
challenges.threshold_hint: Working hypothesis: average participation rate of 25%.
challenges.warmup_hint: The warm-up ranking runs without a prize.

prize.rank_hint: Leave empty for a threshold prize.
prize.check_minutes: Sessions in the period not flagged or released
prize.age_hint: Only outcome, date and checker are stored; no copy of an identity document and no citizen service number.

budget.title: Partners and budget
budget.intro: Only booked revenue or Rewarded's own budget, with a document reference. Obligation next to budget, with coverage ratio.
budget.alarm: Coverage alarm: the coverage ratio is {ratio}. The covered stock value is lower than the value of outstanding points. Point prices and the release schedule do not change; extra stock only comes from signed partner contributions.
budget.weekly_alarm_note: The weekly stock alarm (eligible students against next week's released stock) runs in the week close; contracts v1 has no route to show it here yet.
budget.booked_rule: Booked means invoiced or laid down in a signed contract with amount and date. A commitment without a contract does not count.
budget.pct_hint: 100% for direct funding or own budget; 20% of sponsor revenue; 30% for B2B2C.
budget.document_hint: Invoice, contract or the founder decision for own budget.
budget.list_note: Contracts v1 has no list of budgets. You see the budgets you booked or changed in this session.
budget.list_empty: No budgets in this session yet.
budget.cancel_reason_hint: Lower case and underscores, for example partner_withdrew.
budget.budget_id_hint: Book a budget under Partners and budget first, or paste the id.

catalog.title: Catalogue
catalog.intro: Items with cost price, kind and point price, partner declaration, CSV import, spread release and a reserved share for anchored accounts.
catalog.list_note: Contracts v1 has no list of items for admins. You see the items you created or changed in this session.
catalog.empty: No items in this session yet.
catalog.collective_hint: Something with the squad or the association; shown at the top of the catalogue.
catalog.over_ceiling: Above the cap of {max} per item.
catalog.points_hint: Cost price divided by the budget value per point, rounded to 50; fixed as long as the item exists.
catalog.declaration_hint: Reference to the declaration that this is one product or service, not credit for a range.
catalog.no_declaration: No declaration yet; publishing is not possible.
catalog.import_hint: One code per line; optionally followed by release_week, release_day and anchor_only, separated by commas.
catalog.import_empty: Choose a file or paste codes first.
catalog.cash_check: This is not money and not freely spendable credit.
catalog.cash_check_hint: At level 1 no reward is money or credit for a range.
catalog.published: Published. The point price is now fixed.
catalog.releases_hint: Stock per day (Monday to Sunday), released every day at 04:00.
catalog.anchor_only: Of which only for accounts with an institution anchor
catalog.releases_invalid: Enter a valid week and whole numbers.

waitlist.title: Waiting list
waitlist.intro: Invite in batches, in order of priority. A group gets one invitation together.
waitlist.caption: Waiting per priority class ({total} in total)
waitlist.count_hint: 1 to 500. You first see who goes into the batch.

users.title: Users
users.intro: Searching and viewing only with a reason; every lookup goes into the audit log.
users.reason_hint: For example the support ticket or the flag.
users.search_reason: Enter at least two characters and a reason.
users.name: First name
users.open_flags: {n, plural, =0 {no open flags} one {# open flag} other {# open flags}}
users.delete_hint: Deletion by an admin needs a second admin.
users.delete_pending: Request recorded. A second admin has to confirm the deletion.
users.block_note: Blocking goes through a decision in the fraud queue, with four eyes.

vacation.title: Holiday pause
vacation.intro: In this period streaks, pause counters, Promise days and the goal bonus freeze. Every change gets a log line; closed days do not change.
vacation.invalid: Choose a first and last day, the last not before the first.

experiments.title: Experiments and flags
experiments.intro: Assignment per squad or solo for four factors, from the fixed seed.
experiments.locked_text: The assignment comes from the seed and cannot be changed here.

arm_b.title: Stop arm B
arm_b.intro: Under the stop rule everyone gets arm A from the next Monday. A second admin has to confirm.
arm_b.pending: Request recorded. After confirmation by a second admin it applies from {day}.
arm_b.done: Arm B stops. Everyone has arm A from {day}.

wellbeing.title: Harm signals
wellbeing.intro: Only counts per arm and per code, without names. S4 is a support message with the label wellbeing.
wellbeing.caption: Signals per code and arm

harm.S3: S3: drop-off after a broken streak

flags.title: Flags
flags.intro: Arm B and switching on the rest arm need a second admin; switching the rest arm off does not. Draws are not built.
flags.rule_four_eyes: Four eyes (switching the rest arm off is direct)
flags.rule_draws: Empty placeholder; cannot be switched on

kpi.title: KPI overview
kpi.intro: Stored queries from the measurement plan, per acquisition channel and per association.
kpi.variant_clean: Without accounts the sample found suspect
kpi.team_excluded: Team accounts and rejected sessions never count. The fraud estimate is a lower bound.
kpi.caption: Result: {name}

kpi_name.squad_share: Share of actives in a squad

support.title: Support
support.intro: Tickets from the app and external messages. A ticket labelled wellbeing is only visible to the team member who answers.
support.caption: Tickets
support.label: Label
support.replace_note: Replacement code after a "Does not work" report.
support.wellbeing_note: The label wellbeing creates an S4 signal. Answer personally, with the institution's help resources.
support.external_hint: For an external message we only record the label and the date.

ambassadors.title: Ambassadors
ambassadors.intro: Codes, board-membership check and the count. A board member of a participating association cannot be an ambassador.
ambassadors.caption: Ambassadors
ambassadors.name: Name or reference
ambassadors.payout_missing: Payout with the targeted sample of five accounts has no route in contracts v1 yet and stays blocked as long as the institution anchor is not unique.
ambassadors.board_hint: Choose the association if this person is on a board; the server then refuses.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.intro: Every lookup of session data and every decision: who, when, why.
audit.caption: Audit lines
audit.immutable: The audit log cannot be changed or deleted.
